The underlying system

The default is a designed, closed genus-2 surface: one continuous skin with two through-tunnels. Its asymmetrical lobes twist through real depth, while 180,000 integrated Chen–Čelikovský samples drive the luminous grain. This is an attractor-inspired sculpture, not a claim that the chaotic attractor is a smooth surface. The original trace remains available under Form.

ẋ = 36(y − x)
ẏ = 20y − xz
ż = xy − 3z

Inspired by Paul Bourke's October 2010 reference. The surface is checked for connectivity, manifold edges and Euler characteristic −2. The chaotic trajectory is fixed; its projected density textures the skin. Luminous pulses are artistic, not physical particles. The camera and light return smoothly every loop.
